title: Jagsher Khangurra Assures India a Medal at World Junior Championships, Reaches Semis
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Jagsher Khangurra has guaranteed a medal for India by reaching the semi-finals of the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Khangurra defeated Yuan-Syue Jhuang of Chinese Taipei to secure a spot in the semi-finals of the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships, assuring India of at least a bronze medal. He is set to face Indonesia’s Radithya Bayu Wardhana next.

title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand Reach Quarterfinals; Kidambi Srikanth Exits
indian_angle: India's women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand have advanced to the quarterfinals, continuing their strong performance, while Kidambi Srikanth's campaign ended.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured their spot in the quarterfinals by defeating an Indonesian pair 21-16, 21-17. Meanwhile, Kidambi Srikanth's valiant effort in his match was not enough to progress further in the tournament.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a crucial platform for Indian badminton players to have a direct voice in the sport's governance and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a more significant role in decision-making processes and addressing their concerns.

title: National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is vital for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, fostering future champions.
summary: A national coaching camp is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, specifically to prepare the Indian contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organizes Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course is crucial for elevating the standard of badminton coaching across India, directly impacting player development at all levels.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, aimed at enhancing coaching expertise in the country.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The adoption of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments will significantly change match dynamics and player strategies for young Indian shuttlers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
